summary: Iteration 39 — Focused retest of the two iter-38 fixes on Convert-to-Web-App. Both fixes verified. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter39_lockout_fix.py. (1) Brute-force lockout on POST /api/site/{token}/auth/login now correctly keys off X-Forwarded-For: with a unique X-Forwarded-For IP the sequence is 401,401,401,401,429 (lockout triggers inline on the 5th failure) and stays 429 on subsequent wrong attempts AND on the correct password until the 15-min window elapses. (2) A DIFFERENT email on the same site+IP is unaffected — it still gets 401 on wrong password and 200 on correct password, confirming per-email keying. (3) Conversion now writes protected=false on the four public pages ('/', '/about', '/services', '/contact'); GET /api/apps/{id}/webapp returns a proper boolean (never null) for every page. Full end-to-end regression on a freshly-created throwaway tenant (app created via POST /api/apps → converted): summary payload complete, block props preserved (only props.collection / props.dynamic added), collections endpoint returns a valid list per repeated section, /apps/{id}/webapp/pages/{page_id}/access marks a page protected, /site/{token}/page/{slug} returns requires_login=true anon and full content with a member bearer token, /site/{token}/submit stores a submission, /admin/summary /admin/submissions /admin/users /admin/collections all 200 for the agency owner, and a standard (role='user') member gets 403 on all four /admin/* endpoints. Frontend UI smoke: /site-admin/pv_15f7e07b2d724b452e2a loads for agency owner with all 4 tabs (Submissions, Users, Content, Analytics); tenant header convert-webapp-header-btn and Overview convert-webapp-card still render on app_6663b5de0007.
critical_code_review_comments: site_app.py lines 414-427 (site_login): identifier now correctly resolves X-Forwarded-For (comma-split, first hop) with fallback to X-Real-IP then request.client.host, and uses find_one_and_update with $inc + return_document=True so the incremented count is inspected atomically → 429 is raised inline on the 5th failure (no off-by-one). Correct pw during window also short-circuits at the guard check on line 418 → returns 429, matching the requirement. Good fix.
site_app.py _protect_pages (line 247): now explicitly writes protected=False for public slugs, so GET /webapp never returns null. Confirmed via test.

Minor: the lockout counter never expires per-record on success (unless the correct pw is accepted, which clears via db.site_login_attempts.delete_one). Attempts rows accumulate; consider a TTL index on site_login_attempts.until for cleanup — cosmetic only.

rca of the issue: Prior bug: identifier used request.client.host which behind K8s ingress was the pod-facing IP and varied per replica, so 5 fails were never counted on one row. Fix in site_app.py: fwd = (request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') or request.headers.get('x-real-ip') or ''); ip = fwd.split(',')[0].strip() or client.host; ident = f'{ip}:{app_id}:{email}'. Also switched to find_one_and_update({...}, {$inc:{count:1}, $set:{until:_now+15m}}, upsert=True, return_document=True) so the returned count reflects the post-increment value and the 5th failure triggers 429 inline. Verified: 401×4, then 429 on the 5th (still wrong pw), 429 on 6th, and 429 even on correct pw until window passes. Per-email keying verified: a second email on the same X-Forwarded-For still authenticates cleanly.
